title: security(automation): a paused flow run's stored state keeps record-change values that #21830's mask removes elsewhere — detail withheld pending maintainer
body:
Ruled: 5995381726 · letter A · 2026-10-05T13:25Z

Found by the independent security review of PR #21866 (the fix for #21830). #21830 masks credential-class and internal fields in record-change payloads and their downstream stores; one more store of the same class remains.

- **Class:** authorization (disclosure across the write boundary to holders of a read grant on run state). Under RUNNER rule 2 the detail is **withheld pending maintainer**, held in the PM session (Claude Code session `session_018zT8d8NpiQ1ExhuNd5TxY6`).
- **Direction:** ~~project the trigger record (and its previous values) through the same helper PR #21816 introduced when run state is persisted — or record a maintainer ruling that the run-state read grant is meant to cover these values (an earlier ruling, #7900, declined per-field filtering of the variables map, so this needs a decision).~~ Ruled **A** by the director seat (ruling 5995381726): the record-change trigger's `buildContext` projects the trigger record and its previous values through the one helper at the source, so the flow context, the persisted run state and both read doors inherit the mask; #7900 is untouched (a type-based mask on two record-shaped keys, not per-field filtering).
- **Severity as judged by the reviewer:** medium. **Predates 17.6.0.** Related: #21787, #21830, #21816, #21866.
- **Owning repo:** `objectstack`.
